story.title: Ebola Outbreak in Congo Claims Over 2,000 Lives Amid Containment Challenges
story.summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing a severe Ebola outbreak, which has resulted in more than 2,000 deaths. This outbreak is noted as the fastest-growing in history, with only 30 percent of confirmed cases seeking medical assistance, complicating containment efforts.

timeline_highlights.title: Ebola Outbreak in DR Congo Exceeds 1,000 Deaths
timeline_highlights.summary: The ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has resulted in over 1,000 confirmed deaths, according to official government data. The World Health Organization has indicated that the actual number of cases may be significantly higher, potentially two to four times the reported figures.
key_facts: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo has killed over 1,000 people.

WHO suggests the true scale of the outbreak could be much larger.

timeline_highlights.title: Ebola Workers in DR Congo Threaten Strikes Over Unpaid Salaries Amid Outbreak
timeline_highlights.summary: Frontline health workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo, particularly in Ituri province, are threatening to strike due to unpaid salaries while battling a significant Ebola outbreak. The World Health Organization has noted that the outbreak is advancing faster than the response efforts, raising concerns about healthcare access and the potential for staff shortages to hinder containment efforts.
key_facts: Frontline health workers in DR Congo are at risk of quitting due to unpaid salaries.
The Ebola outbreak is worsening, particularly in Ituri province.
The WHO has indicated that the outbreak is outpacing response efforts.

timeline_highlights.title: DR Congo Faces Rapid Resurgence of Ebola Epidemic
timeline_highlights.summary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo is grappling with a significant resurgence of Ebola, having recorded nearly 4,000 confirmed cases and over 1,800 deaths. This outbreak, attributed to the Bundibugyo virus, is now the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history and the fastest-spreading in the country's records.

timeline_highlights.title: Ebola Outbreak in Congo Claims Over 2,000 Lives, Marked as Fastest Growing on Record
timeline_highlights.summary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports that at least 2,000 people have died in its ongoing Ebola outbreak, which is now recognized as the fastest growing on record. As of the latest updates, there have been 4,381 confirmed cases across five provinces. The outbreak reportedly began months before it was officially declared in May, complicating response efforts due to factors such as rebel conflict and infrastructure challenges.
